name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention (domain=battle/progression). Name accurately describes the body: roll one stat's gain from a 2-byte growth pair, show the level-up/promotion message, and apply the gain. No Ghidra address residue in the name.
purpose: Roll a single character stat's growth gain (level-up or class promotion), show its FDTXT message row, and apply the gain to the stat.
logic_summary: min_gain = growth_pair[0]; range = growth_pair[1] - growth_pair[0] (growth_pair[1] is max+1 per char_growth_entry, so the roll spans [min,max]); rand_extra = range ? fd2_advance_rng_state() % range : 0; gain = min_gain + rand_extra, stashed into data_fd2_dialog_last_action_value_param (0x53AE1) for the dialog -6 LITERAL-NUMBER opcode. Only when gain != 0: if row_idx==3 (4th/bottom row) scroll up one row and use row 2; clear kb; render dialog page dialog_text_id at row_idx*0x17C0 + 0xA951F; add gain (low 16 bits) to *stat_ptr; row_idx++. Returns next row index (unchanged when gain==0). Tail at entry+0x90 (0x1E5B9) is a shared epilogue also reached by tail-JMP from fd2_animate_warp_out_collapse.
signature: int fd2_roll_stat_gain_and_show_message(short *stat_ptr, uint8 *growth_pair, uint32 dialog_text_id, int row_idx)

params.name: stat_ptr
params.semantics: Pointer to the 16-bit stat to increase (AP at combat_aux+0x10, DP at +0x12, DX at ai_target_and_dx_block+1, hp_max, or mp_max). Gain is added to *stat_ptr (low 16 bits).
params.reason: Accurately names the stat output pointer; matches usage in both callers. No address residue.

params.name: growth_pair
params.semantics: Pointer to a 2-byte char_growth_entry stat field: byte[0]=min gain, byte[1]=max gain+1. range = byte[1]-byte[0]; callers pass growth_table + {0,2,4,6,8} for the five stat slots.
params.reason: Name reflects the (min,max+1) growth pair it points at. No address residue.

params.name: dialog_text_id
params.semantics: FDTXT page id for the stat-name message (0x1EA STR, 0x1EB CON, 0x1EC DEX, 0x1ED HP, 0x1EE MP), passed to fd2_display_dialog_scene.
params.reason: Name matches its use as the dialog page selector. No address residue.

params.name: row_idx
params.semantics: Message row index. Chained across the five per-call invocations (each call returns the next row) so the stat messages cascade down the 4-row dialog area; row 3 triggers a scroll-up and reuse of row 2.
params.reason: Name correctly conveys the cascading row counter; confirmed by caller chaining (row -> row). No address residue.

returns.semantics: Next message row index: row_idx+1 when a gain was shown/applied, or the unchanged row_idx when gain==0 (no message).

comment_original_issue: src comment block was accurate (incl. the Ghidra EAX-tracking-bug note that the RNG return value is the modulo dividend, not growth_pair) but described growth_pair as (min,max); per the char_growth_entry KB layout byte[1] is max+1. Augmented the comment to state byte[0]=min, byte[1]=max+1 so range = (max+1)-min reads correctly.
notes: Disasm @ 0x1E529 confirms true signature/behavior: arg0=stat_ptr ([ESP+0x14], ADD word[EDX],AX), arg1=growth_pair ([ESP+0x18], MOVZX min/max), arg2=dialog_text_id ([ESP+0x38]), arg3=row_idx ([ESP+0x20]). The decompiler's scrambled param names (param_1/param_2/stat_ptr) are an artifact; src signature and both callers agree on the documented order. RNG modulo: CALL 0x4E893 (fd2_advance_rng_state) -> MOV EDX,EAX; SAR EDX,0x1F; IDIV ESI -> EDX = rng % range. Global 0x53AE1 label in Ghidra = data_fd2_dialog_last_action_value_param (byte-identical to src). Logic untouched (comment-only refinement).
